description: Publishing the Animal Welfare Bill in the Government Gazette
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-06-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - An Expert Committee has been appointed by the Secretary to the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, as per the Cabinet decision dated 2025.12.29, to examine the provisions of the Bill prepared pertaining to animal welfare and submit appropriate recommendations. The Legal Draftsman has been instructed at the Cabinet meeting held on 18.05.2026 to prepare the final Bill on Animal Welfare based on the recommendations submitted by the said Committee. Accordingly, the Legal Draftsman has prepared the Animal Welfare Bill, and the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to publish the Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter submit the same to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
